# E0608: the lineage imports a package that is not available here

The lineage imports a package no module provides. Only thema's own module
is built in; another module must be listed in the deps of a cue.mod/module.cue
above the lineage, for the loader to fetch it.

## Example

`pkg/x.cue`:

```cue
package x

import "example.com/nothere"

lin: nothere.Lineage
```

`data.json`:

```json
{"a": "Argo"}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0608]: the lineage imports example.com/nothere, which is not available here
 --> pkg/x.cue:3:8
  |
3 | import "example.com/nothere"
  |        ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  |
  = help: only github.com/sdboyer/thema is built in; another module must be declared in the deps of a cue.mod/module.cue above the lineage
```
